question: Will AfD win the most seats in the Baden-Württemberg Landtag election?
summary: Current credible polls place CDU and Greens ahead of AfD in Baden-Württemberg, making AfD the most likely to finish behind the top two.
Objections raise plausible upside risks (late surge, turnout effects, poll undercount) but do not indicate a systematic miscalibration of the ensemble.
Historical base-rate shows AfD has never led BW in the Landtag, supporting a very low probability of becoming the largest party unless a substantial shift occurs.
There is no explicit numeric threshold for top-seat performance; even with possible late shifts, current data do not justify revising the ensemble upward.

justification.critique_assessment: Objections valid in acknowledging upside risks but do not reveal a systematic error in the ensemble; the current data still imply a very low chance of AfD winning the most seats.
justification.adjustment: No adjustment; keep the ensemble probability at 0.02 and reflect only minimal range around it.
